title: hieracium alatum subsp. doronicoides
intro: Hieracium alatum subsp. doronicoides, commonly known as the Hawkweed, is a species of flowering plant in the dandelion family. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help to reduce pain and inflammation, and protect against cell damage and oxidative stress. The therapeutic actions of Hieracium alatum subsp. doronicoides include its ability to exhibit immunomodulatory, antimicrobial, and anti-tumor activities, making it a promising natural remedy for various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, such as quercetin and kaempferol, as well as sesquiterpenes and other phenolic compounds that contribute to its medicinal properties.
